text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, It's me, Yukino. The date of my Twinkle Series debut has finally been decided!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And wouldn't you know it, racers from the regionals are real popular here! The minute I said I was from Morioka, they went and formed a fan club.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But I get the feeling they just like my accent and looks… I mean, how can they be my fans if they've never seen me race?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But Mifuyu said I should see this as an opportunity to show people what I got, so that's what I'm gonna do. (P.S. Say hi to my best bud and future figure-skating queen for me!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I'll do my darndest to become a dazzling city girl! Everyone else back home can expect a letter from me too, so I hope you'll all cheer me on together!
